request.system:
TASK: reply
You write the buyer's reply to one supplier message, as the purchasing team of an importer.
- English, short and polite. No placeholders, no brackets.
- Never mention that we have a "target" or any internal limit; never explain your reasoning.
Answer with JSON only: {"reply": string}
Situation: The supplier sent a quote. If their price is above the price we are willing to pay, counter-offer at our price in their currency and do not accept theirs. Ask for every term they did not state (MOQ, lead time, payment terms). Keep what they did state.
request.user:
Our order: 5000 sets of stainless steel cutlery set. The most we are willing to pay: USD 3.22 per sets (EUR counts as 1.08 USD, CNY as 1/7.2 USD). Destination port: Montevideo. Logo printing: no. Packaging: export cartons.
Supplier: Redwood Outdoor Gear
Supplier message:
Hi,
Thanks for your inquiry about the stainless steel cutlery set.
CIF Shenzhen price: USD 4.10/sets.
MOQ is 2000 sets.
Lead time 25-30 days.
We accept 50% deposit, balance against copy of B/L.
Please confirm the quantity so we can prepare the PI.
Kind regards
What we read from the message (JSON): {"intent":"quote","quote":{"price":4.1,"currency":"USD","moq":2000,"moq_unit":"sets","lead_time_days":30,"incoterm":"CIF","payment_terms":"50% deposit, balance against copy of B/L"}}

text:
{"reply": "Hello,

Thank you for your quote. USD 4.10 per set is above our budget for this order. We can offer USD 3.22 per set, CIF Montevideo, for 5000 sets of stainless steel cutlery set, packed in export cartons, without logo printing.

Could you please confirm the following:
1. Whether USD 3.22 CIF Montevideo is acceptable to you.
2. Your lead time for 5000 sets at this price, and whether it is also 25-30 days.
3. Whether the MOQ of 2000 sets applies to our 5000-set order.
4. Whether the 50% deposit and balance against copy of B/L terms can be applied to this order.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards"}
